The Revolutionary Egypt Party () is a political party that calls for the establishment of a presidential parliamentary system, "an independent judiciary system" and an economic system where the state intervenes to prevent monopolization. It is currently led by Hussien Abu Al-Atta.
The name of the Egyptian Revolution Party was changed to the Egyptians Party in May 2019. In 2023, Hussein Abu Al-Atta, a prominent Egyptians Party member, indicated support for President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi's 2024 presidential run.
